metadata.source: State of New Jersey Local Finance Board & Pompton Lakes Borough Audits

controversies.title: Ratable Base Balance & Assessment Equalization (Pompton Lakes Borough)
controversies.entityInvolved: Pompton Lakes Borough Governing Body & Tax Assessor
controversies.summary: Downtown redevelopment district balancing flood mitigation infrastructure and independent K-12 school budget requirements.
controversies.investigationDetails: Annual watchdog audit of municipal tax appeal exposure, commercial assessment accuracy, and county equalized tax distribution.
controversies.taxpayerImpact: Homeowners bear 85.1% of all property taxes raised in Pompton Lakes Borough.
controversies.status: Monitored Under NJ DLGS & County Tax Board Guidelines

controversies.title: Public School District Budget Growth & S2 State Aid Adjustments
controversies.entityInvolved: Pompton Lakes Borough Board of Education
controversies.summary: Public education appropriations represent 57.1% of the composite property tax levy in Pompton Lakes Borough.
controversies.investigationDetails: Watchdog analysis of per-pupil spending ($21,800/student) and health benefit premium cost-sharing under Chapter 44.
controversies.taxpayerImpact: Annual school tax increases are capped at 2% under statutory levy limits unless statutory health care or enrollment adjustments apply.
controversies.status: Under Annual State DOE User-Friendly Budget Review

controversies.title: Commercial Development Tax Abatements (PILOT Shift)
controversies.entityInvolved: Pompton Lakes Borough Municipal Redevelopment Agency
controversies.summary: Commercial PILOT agreements in Pompton Lakes Borough yield $151,551 in service fees while abating standard property taxes.
controversies.investigationDetails: Under NJ Long-Term Tax Exemption Law, municipal government retains 95% of PILOT revenues, leaving local school districts with 0% of payments.
controversies.taxpayerImpact: Shifts an estimated $27.55 per homeowner annually in indirect education funding burden.
